title: 第二章，穿书作者，狗咬吕洞宾，不识好人心
slug: 末日求生欧皇女配在线摇人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

端木棠梨话音刚落，米樱闻笙和米樱昭雪立即加料，踩着他们尸体从这里出去。

端木棠梨手里头没有行李，想要帮小雪的忙，被米樱昭雪拒绝了。

“大小姐，你负责指挥大局，这些小事老奴一人做就够了。”

眼见事情解决差不多，米樱昭雪又有心情cos小仆人。

端木棠梨想想自己一行人的行李不多，用不着所有人都去检查，就把注意力放到过道上那些幽灵身上。

在列车广播开启后，列车开始走动起来，过道上的幽灵一改之前的静止状态，慢悠悠在过道上走着，看到空位就坐了下去，中途没有任何暴起的情况，温顺不可思议。

端木棠梨都怀疑自己疑心病太重，把幽灵想的太坏，其实人家是个好诡，不杀生的。

就在端木棠梨精神恍惚之际，眼前情形发生翻天覆地的变化。

原本幽灵温和无害，在过道上飘了一阵子就找个空位位置坐下，诡异和人之间和平相处。

然而当车厢里面的座位被人和诡异瓜分，剩余一些幽灵没有座位，气氛就显得有些微妙起来。

没人乐意站起来，给这些没位置的幽灵让座，谁知道没有位置的人会不会触发死亡规则，死道友不死贫道，何况还是一群类人怪物。

就在众人都以为这种情况要持续很久，那些幽灵要等到有人安全成功坐到下一个站点，才能有空位置坐下。

突然列车比较靠前的位置，传来一道苍老的声音，“小伙子，爷爷没位置坐，麻烦你让个坐可好。”

把众人吓了一跳，目光齐刷刷看向声音来源处，发现是一个长相苍老的幽灵在和之前被嚣张跋扈富家子骂做蠢货的人交流。

大伙面面相觑，眼神都透露出同一种意思，原来这些诡异生物会说人话，他们还以为它们只是长得像人的怪物。

“我不要，你没位置坐关我什么事情。”

倒霉的男人想也不想直接拒绝幽灵爷爷的请求，哪怕他也被这些之前像是大傻子一样，只会依靠本能在过道上来回游荡的幽灵突然开口说话给吓到，但依旧哆嗦着身体强硬拒绝对方要求。

Page (1/3)

As soon as Duanmu Tangli finished speaking, Miying Wensheng and Miying Zhaoxue immediately added more information and walked out of here stepping on their corpses.

Duanmu Tangli had no luggage and wanted to help Xiaoxue, but Miying Zhaoxue refused.

"Miss, you are responsible for directing the overall situation. It is enough for me to do these small things by myself."

Seeing that the matter was almost resolved, Miying Zhaoxue was in the mood to cosplay the little servant again.

Duanmu Tangli thought about the fact that his group's luggage was not much, so he didn't need everyone to check it, so he focused his attention on the ghosts in the aisle.

After the train announcement was turned on, the train began to move. The ghost in the aisle changed from its previous static state and walked slowly along the aisle. When it saw an empty seat, it sat down without any sudden disturbances along the way. It was incredibly docile.

Duanmu Tangli suspected that she was too paranoid and thought too bad about ghosts. In fact, she was a very cunning person who did not kill animals.

Just when Duanmu Tangli was in a trance, the situation in front of him changed drastically.

The ghost was originally gentle and harmless. It floated in the aisle for a while and then found an empty seat to sit down. The ghosts and humans coexisted peacefully.

However, when the seats in the carriage were divided between humans and ghosts, and the remaining ghosts had no seats, the atmosphere became a little subtle.

No one is willing to stand up and give up their seat to these ghosts who have no place. Who knows whether people who have no place will trigger the death rule, dead Taoist friends, not to mention a group of humanoid monsters.

Just when everyone thought that this situation would last for a long time, those ghosts would have to wait until someone safely and successfully sat at the next station before they could find a free seat.

Suddenly, an old voice came from a seat near the front of the train, "Young man, Grandpa doesn't have a seat. Could you please give me a seat?"

Everyone was startled, and they all looked at the source of the sound, and found that it was an old-looking ghost communicating with the person who had been called a fool by the arrogant and domineering rich boy before.

Everyone looked at each other with the same meaning in their eyes. It turned out that these strange creatures could speak human language, and they thought they were just monsters that looked like humans.

"I don't want it. You have no place to worry about my business."

The unlucky man didn't even think about rejecting Grandpa Ghost's request directly. Even though he was frightened by the ghosts who had previously acted like fools and only relied on instinct to wander back and forth in the aisles, suddenly spoke, he still refused the request with a trembling body.
